     643: function toAbsoluteProductUrl(value: unknown) {
     644:   const text = String(value || "").trim();
     645: 
     646:   if (!text) {
     647:     return "";
     648:   }
     649: 
     650:   if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(text)) {
     651:     return text;
     652:   }
     653: 
     654:   return `${PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN}${text.startsWith("/") ? text : `/${text}`}`;
     655: }

     657: function collectProductImageUrls(data: any) {
     658:   const values: unknown[] = [
     659:     data.mainImage,
     660:     data.imageUrl,
     661:     data.image,
     662:     data.heroImage,
     663:     data.coverImage,
     664:     ...(Array.isArray(data.images) ? data.images : []),
     665:     ...(Array.isArray(data.galleryImages) ? data.galleryImages : []),
     666:   ];
     667: 
     668:   const urls = values
     669:     .flatMap((value) => {
     670:       if (typeof value === "string") {
     671:         return [value];
     672:       }
     673: 
     674:       if (value && typeof value === "object") {
     675:         const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
     676:         return [item.src, item.url, item.path, item.fullPath];
     677:       }
     678: 
     679:       return [];
     680:     })
     681:     .map(toAbsoluteProductUrl)
     682:     .filter(Boolean);
     683: 
     684:   return Array.from(new Set(urls));
     685: }
